name: FastTrack Communications
notes:
FastTrack Communications (AS30688) is accepting bilateral IPv4 and IPv6 peering requests at Any2Denver.

We are coordinating migration of existing IX-Denver peerings to Any2Denver. Existing IX-Denver sessions will remain in service until replacement sessions are established, validated, and retirement is coordinated with each peer. No IX-Denver shutdown date is currently announced.

Please use the listed Policy contact for peering requests and migration coordination.
